subject: Nimbus Health — request for evaluation extension and pricing flexibility
messages:
From: Sara King <sara.king@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodai.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional time & potential credits for Redwood eval

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the KV-cache behavior. We're running into a timing problem on our side: our clinical data ingestion is delayed and we won't have a full evaluation dataset ready until the end of August.

We originally agreed to a 30-day pilot that begins 8/1, but given the ingestion delay we're asking if Redwood can:
- extend the pilot by an additional 30 days (so trial window would cover through end of September)
- or alternatively provide usage credits (~$10k-$15k) to make up for the shortened evaluation period

We have strict procurement windows and a limited evaluation budget. If those concessions are possible we'd be grateful — ideally we'd like to finalize this week so procurement can prepare a PO.

Appreciate it,
Sara King
Dir., AI Platforms
Nimbus Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodai.com>

Subject: Re: Request: additional time & potential credits for Redwood eval

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for the clear ask. Really glad the demo resonated.

Two quick clarifying questions so I can route this properly:
1) What constrained your ingestion timeline — is the data arrive date now the week of 8/31 or later?
2) Do you need full feature parity for the extra 30 days, or would a phased evaluation (limited tokens / sampling) work if we provide credits?

Tentatively we can offer two paths:
- 30-day no-cost extension to the pilot window (same capacity)
- OR a 60% usage credit up to $12,000 applied to the pilot account (usable through the original pilot end date)

I'll need quick signoff from my manager on the exact credit amount; if you can confirm the timeline and preferred path I'll escalate immediately. I'm attaching a proposed pricing worksheet that maps credits to expected token consumption (redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx).

Best,

- Approve $8k credit + SOW addendum & DOC (lower credit than requested) — helps close procurement but reduce discount exposure.

Deal context: mid-market, potential ARR $150k+, competitive evaluation vs. two other vendors, procurement is time-boxed. I attached a draft SOW for signatures.
